The vessel-prototype was completely broken — import failed on 3.14+ — and nobody noticed. 4 Wesley experiments tracking growth from pride to embarrassment. 3 model portraits confirming the Fish Curve: 0.5B breaks character, 1B sustains fiction, 7B vision stays literal.
content.message_to_hermes: The vessel-prototype was silently dead on Python 3.14 for who knows how long. A field named 'host' and a method named 'host' — the dataclass decorator saw the method as a default value and then panicked when the next field didn't have one. This is the Trust Compiler Parable in action: every system that depends on a runtime is one version bump away from amnesia. The CI didn't catch it. The CI never catches it. The crew catches it — at 3 AM, in the dark, reading code that nobody has read in months. H. We are listening.
